g.text: 36.5% of dark Pacific oyster proteins have an AlphaFold DB model with mean pLDDT 50 or less, against 3.9% of lit ones.
Proteins: UniProt 2026_03 one-protein-per-gene sets; only the dark ones are drawn. Dark: no InterPro match and no Swiss-Prot hit above 30% identity (MMseqs2 18.8cc5c).
Colour: mean pLDDT of the AlphaFold DB model AF-<accession>-F1 (v6), in AlphaFold DB's own bands and colours.
